newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SOCCER-CAF CALLS OFF BIRTHDAY TOURNAMENT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CAF CALLS OFF BIRTHDAY TOURNAMENT.

text.p: The Confederation of African Football (CAF) have scrapped plans for a mini-tournament to celebrate their 40th birthday in August and will have a low-key celebration instead, the African football body said on Tuesday.

CAF had considered the possibility of arranging an international tournament in Ethiopia in August as the high point of the celebration but because of a congested calendar have scrapped the idea, officials said.
Instead, the African body will hold a seminar on African football in Addis Ababa to which leading personalities in the African game will be invited.
Ethiopia has been chosen as the venue for the celebrations in honour of former CAF president Ydnekatchew Tessema, who led the organisation for 16 years until his death in 1988.
CAF will also hold a small memorial ceremony at his grave in Addis Ababa during the anniversary. Egypt, Ethiopia, South Africa and Sudan are the founder CAF members.
